verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both stack the design sensibly but share the same flaws: the stained-glass window takes up most of the canvas and dwarfs the headline, which is small for the format. The date line sits off-centre and doesn't line up with the left-aligned address beneath it. The date and address are small and cramped at the bottom, while there are wide empty margins on the right and left.
